found.F1: finding, product (reset lifecycle of P4): Redis changing while a recovery waits for the event gate. At the first wait one restart cost two generations; at the second wait a lost epoch could be written anew without a reset (also on main, when the namespace is lost without a change of the process). Fixed in 92e1250 and e617e0e by the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-04; R2 and R3 and two lifecycle tests pass since
